# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen or eighteen years old  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v2 c26 P46](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0046)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** Single  <sub>[v2 c26 P46](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0046)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher at White Sands  <sub>[v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Gil  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c25 P55](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0055)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall, handsome boy with curly brown hair, hazel eyes, and a teazingly twisted mouth. He has a fair, frank face and broad shoulders. As he matures toward adulthood, he maintains a tall, erect, and manly bearing.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c31 P15](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0015), [v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

## Personality

Gilbert is intelligent, ambitious, and determined, consistently competing for the top academic honors in his class. He possesses a mischievous, teasing sense of humor, yet displays genuine chivalry, warmth, and persistence. Though sometimes outspoken, he is quick to apologize when he realizes he has offended someone, and he holds deep loyalty toward his friends and community.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v2 c1 P55](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0055), [v2 c4 P12](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0012), [v2 c7 P12](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0012)_

## History

Gilbert Blythe returned to Avonlea after spending three years in Alberta with his sick father, resuming his studies at Avonlea School. On his first day back, he teased Anne Shirley by pulling her hair and calling her 'Carrots,' causing her to smash her slate over his head. Though he immediately apologized, Anne held a long grudge against him. Despite this rivalry, Gilbert consistently vied with Anne for the top academic position in their class. They both attended Queen's Academy, where Gilbert studied for his First Class teacher's license and eventually tied with Anne for first place, winning the Governor-General's Medal. Because his father could not afford college immediately, Gilbert took the White Sands school to earn his tuition. Hearing that Anne wished to stay at Green Gables to care for Marilla Cuthbert, Gilbert generously gave up his application for the Avonlea school so Anne could teach there instead. This selfless act led Anne to forgive him, and they established a close friendship. Together with Anne and other youth, he helped found the Avonlea Village Improvement Society, becoming its president. He later announced his ambition to become a doctor and work toward improving the world.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c32 P40](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0040), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v1 c38 P50](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0050), [v1 c38 P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055), [v2 c1 P55](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0055), [v2 c6 P9](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0009), [v2 c7 P13](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0013), [v2 c7 P14](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0014)_
